overviewDescription: ⚠️ A definitive public spec sheet for 'Noki A9-F4' could not be located. 'F4' commonly denotes a direct-drive single-needle lockstitch machine — this naming/format is used widely across Chinese-market brands such as Jack, Typical, Sera, etc., for direct-drive lockstitch heads. Typical specs for this class of machine: stitch type lockstitch (single needle, straight stitch), max sewing speed ≈4,000–5,000 sti/min (adjustable via direct-drive motor control), max stitch length ≈5 mm, needle bar stroke ≈31–31.8 mm, presser foot lift ≈5 mm (hand) / 13–15 mm (knee), needle DB×1 #9–#18, motor built-in direct-drive servo (no belt).
